#!/bin/bash

# Docker Cleanup Script
# Uses environment variables for configuration

# Default values
DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL=${DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL:-"86400"} # 24 hours in seconds
CLEANUP_SCOPE=${CLEANUP_SCOPE:-"all"} # all, images, containers, volumes, networks
FILTER_LABEL=${FILTER_LABEL:-""} # Label filter for cleanup
FILTER_UNTIL=${FILTER_UNTIL:-"24h"} # Age filter for cleanup
DRY_RUN=${DRY_RUN:-"false"} # Whether to do a dry run

echo "Docker Cleanup Configuration:"
echo "============================"
echo "Cleanup Interval: $DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL seconds"
echo "Cleanup Scope: $CLEANUP_SCOPE"
echo "Label Filter: $FILTER_LABEL"
echo "Age Filter: $FILTER_UNTIL"
echo "Dry Run Mode: $DRY_RUN"
echo ""

# Function to perform cleanup based on scope
perform_cleanup() {
    local scope=$1
    local dry_run_flag=""
    
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
        dry_run_flag="--dry-run"
    fi
    
    echo "Starting Docker cleanup..."
    
    case $scope in
        "images")
            echo "Cleaning up unused images..."
            docker image prune -a -f --filter "until=$FILTER_UNTIL" $dry_run_flag
            ;;
        "containers")
            echo "Cleaning up stopped containers..."
            docker container prune -f --filter "until=$FILTER_UNTIL" $dry_run_flag
            ;;
        "volumes")
            echo "Cleaning up unused volumes..."
            docker volume prune -f --filter "label=$FILTER_LABEL" $dry_run_flag
            ;;
        "networks")
            echo "Cleaning up unused networks..."
            docker network prune -f --filter "label=$FILTER_LABEL" $dry_run_flag
            ;;
        "all"|*)
            echo "Cleaning up everything..."
            docker image prune -a -f --filter "until=$FILTER_UNTIL" $dry_run_flag
            docker container prune -f --filter "until=$FILTER_UNTIL" $dry_run_flag
            docker volume prune -f --filter "label=$FILTER_LABEL" $dry_run_flag
            docker network prune -f --filter "label=$FILTER_LABEL" $dry_run_flag
            ;;
    esac
    
    echo "Docker cleanup completed."
}

# Main execution
if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then
    echo "Running in DRY RUN mode - no actual cleanup will be performed"
fi

# Perform cleanup based on configured scope
perform_cleanup "$CLEANUP_SCOPE"

# Schedule next cleanup if running as a daemon
if [ "$DAEMON_MODE" = "true" ]; then
    echo "Scheduling next cleanup in $DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL seconds"
    sleep $DEFAULT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL
fi
